commits.message: fix(diagnostics): renderTemplate keeps its doc, takes RenderOptions' fields so a wrapping renderable forwards them whole, and its docs say what a theme reaches (rich-diagnostics-t782)

feat(diagnostics): renderToString and renderTemplate render theme names and report bad styles the way Console does (rich-diagnostics-t782)

renderToString takes a theme, so strict onStyleError holds for themed
content. renderTemplate takes theme and onStyleError; only compile and
evaluate sit inside its try, so a rethrown style error leaves the call
instead of becoming an [error: ...] segment.

fix(markdown): list items hold blocks, h1 is centred, inline links parse fully (rich-markdown-ht8e) (#297)

* fix(markdown): list items hold blocks, h1 is centred, inline links parse fully (rich-markdown-ht8e)

A list item is now a container, tokenized as Markdown of its own under its
content column, the way a quote already was: fences, quotes and nested lists
inside an item survive, nesting is drawn from the parent's text column, a
number short of the content column is a sibling, numbering counts on from the
first item, and a marker four columns in is indented code.

Lazy continuation is one rule for quotes and items. Outside a container no
paragraph is open, so any list item ends it: "> a\n2024. b" now opens a list,
as CommonMark and Rich read it.

h1 centres per row and h2+ stay left; the heading style is the text's own,
so centring pads beside it. Inline text is parsed rather than matched: link
URLs keep balanced parentheses, link text is inline Markdown, and an image
draws as Rich's ImageItem does.

* fix(markdown): lines keep their source columns inside containers; link text styles win; linear reading (rich-markdown-ht8e)

A container's lines now carry their container's content column instead of
being cut, so tabs reach their source stops at any depth and a fence, quote
or heading may sit up to three columns into an item. A thematic break wins
over a list item; `===` alone is text. Code tabs are expanded at Syntax's 8.
A link's text styles sit over the link's own. Lazy continuation reads its
container once per run, and inline brackets pair in one pass.

* fix(markdown): a lazy continuation line is only ever paragraph text (rich-markdown-ht8e)
